identity.vendor: Prometheus Authors (Cloud Native Computing Foundation, graduated project)

freePlan.limits: Entirely free and open source under the Apache 2.0 license; no paid tier from the project itself.

keyLimits.en: Free to self-host; statically linked binaries with no external dependencies. No official managed/hosted offering from the Prometheus project itself.

cautions.en: Prometheus itself has no paid plan or vendor; hosting costs and managed-service offerings (e.g. from cloud providers) are separate and not covered by the project's own site.

capabilities.en: Dimensional data model for time series metrics with flexible key-value labeling.
PromQL query language for real-time metric transformation and correlation.
Built-in alerting rule engine paired with a separate Alertmanager for notification routing and silencing.
Hundreds of official and community-contributed exporters/integrations for extracting metrics from existing systems.

limitations.en: No official managed/hosted version; teams must self-host and operate the storage, scaling and high-availability setup themselves.
No built-in long-term dashboarding UI comparable to Grafana; visualization typically requires a separate tool.

reason.en: Commercial, fully managed monitoring and metrics platform covering similar time-series alerting use cases without self-hosting.
Commonly paired with or compared to Prometheus for dashboarding and visualization of monitoring data.
Managed monitoring and alerting alternative for teams that don't want to operate Prometheus themselves.

missingAlternatives.name: VictoriaMetrics
missingAlternatives.reason: Prometheus-compatible open-source and managed time-series monitoring alternative, not in the catalogue.

unknowns: Supported deployment platforms beyond Kubernetes/containers were not detailed on the homepage checked.
